meta.source: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure public price list (on-demand)
notes: Compute priced as OCPU/hr + Memory GB/hr for Flex shapes
ARM (Ampere A1) treated as 1 OCPU = 1 vCPU for this tool
Block Volume has a single base storage price; HDD/SSD UI maps to same base price
DenseIO and Optimized shapes are intentionally excluded for apple-to-apple comparison

windows.note: Modeled as Windows Server license uplift over Linux compute; ARM is not supported for Windows

storage.note: OCI Block Volume base price is identical for HDD and SSD; performance is controlled via VPUs and is not modeled here
